_comment: Per-species baseSpecies / forme overrides. Applied to
the base build. Use when upstream's baseSpecies points at the wrong
base for the team-builder's model — e.g. meowsticfmega should be a
forme of meowsticf (the female base), not meowstic (male). The mega
stone's megaStone mapping is the source of truth for which base a
mega belongs to; this file just makes the pokedex agree.
Both fields are optional — only fields you list are touched.
